Usage: gaia search lkm auth [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Manage the LKM access key (login / status / logout / rotate).

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ login   Show setup instructions, prompt for an access key, validate it, and  │
│         persist to file.                                                     │
│ status  Report where the LKM access key is sourced from and its display      │
│         form.                                                                │
│ logout  Purge the stored access key (idempotent).                            │
│ rotate  Replace the stored access key: silent logout, then login.            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 Examples:
 gaia search lkm auth login
 gaia search lkm auth status
 What you have:
 no key yet             ->  login
 check the stored key   ->  status
 replace the key        ->  rotate
 remove the stored key  ->  logout
 The access key lives in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gaia/credentials.toml`.
 GAIA_LKM_ACCESS_KEY / LKM_ACCESS_KEY shadows the file; login / logout / rotate
 refuse while an env var is set.
